value.rationale: The FA2f dynamical-arrest model motivates the natural full microstate census on the smallest quasi-one-dimensional 2D cylinder. A precise odd/even decomposition yields every facilitator-resolved coefficient, probability of complete freezing at arbitrary Bernoulli density and its nonzero entropy density, plus a parity-frustrated maximal filling at n=2 modulo 6. Existing bipartite-prism extremal results do not answer this weighted finite-volume physical question. The contribution is a complete natural classification, not an arbitrary slice or mere renamed parameter.
